svg.title: Local extrema and a point of inflection of f(x) = x³ − 6x² + 9x
svg.desc: The graph of f(x) = x³ − 6x² + 9x for −0.4 ≤ x ≤ 4.4. It increases to a local maximum at (1, 4), decreases to a local minimum at (3, 0), then increases. Its point of inflection is (2, 2), where it changes from concave down to concave up.
